title: Implement TC-2 & TC-3: Task Context Persistence Service and API Endpoints
description: Implement the persistence layer and REST API for task context capture system (TC-2 and TC-3 from stabilization plan). Build on the schema and migration completed in TC-1.
acceptanceCriteria: TaskContextService class created with CRUD operations for context data
API endpoints implemented: POST /api/tasks (with context), GET /api/tasks/:id/context, GET /api/tasks/:id/runs, GET /api/tasks/:id/runs/:runId
Integration with existing TaskQueueManager to accept context on task creation
Unit tests for TaskContextService covering all CRUD operations
API integration tests for context submission and retrieval
All existing tests continue to pass
TypeScript compilation succeeds with no errors
architectureReferences: backend/src/types/taskContext.ts - Schema definitions and Zod validators
longTermGoals: Enable rich diagnostic context capture for every task
Provide full execution trail visibility for dev-bot automation
Support data-driven improvements to automation system
Enable debugging of failed automation runs with full context
prerequisites: TC-1 completed: taskContext.ts types and 004_task_context.sql migration exist
Database migration has been applied (tables exist)
Existing TaskQueueManager and database services are functional

mustNotAffect: Frontend task creation forms (will be enhanced later)
Current task status and assignment flow
integrationPoints: TaskQueueManager.createTask - extend to accept optional context
DevBotsDatabase service - add context persistence methods

validationSteps: Run `npm run test:backend` - all tests pass
Run `npm run build -w backend` - TypeScript compiles without errors
Verify TaskContextService unit tests cover: saveCreationContext, getCreationContext, saveExecutionContext, getExecutionContext, listExecutionRuns
Verify API tests cover: POST with context, GET context, GET runs list, GET specific run
Check database.ts has methods: saveTaskContext, getTaskContext, saveAutomationRun, getAutomationRun, listTaskRuns
Verify TaskQueueManager.createTask accepts optional context parameter
rollbackPlan: All changes in new files (taskContextService.ts) - can be removed
Database service changes are additive - backwards compatible
API routes are new endpoints - no breaking changes
Migration already applied but context_json column allows NULL
successMetrics: All unit tests pass (target: 100% coverage for new service)
Can create task with context via API
Can retrieve task context and runs via API
Existing task creation (without context) still works
testingRequirements: Test database constraints and foreign keys
documentationRequirements: JSDoc comments for all public methods
API endpoint documentation in route file
assumptions: TC-1 migration has been applied to database
Existing TaskQueueManager interface can be extended backwards-compatibly
Context submission is optional (tasks can be created without context)
Initial implementation stores context as JSON in database (not normalized)
risks: Database performance with large JSON blobs in context_json column
Context payloads could be very large (need truncation strategy)
Backwards compatibility with existing task creation code
alternatives: Normalize context data into separate tables (more complex, better for queries)
Store large artifacts on filesystem with DB references (chosen approach)
Use separate service vs extending TaskQueueManager (chosen: separate service)
